pmdocLocalFailureAndWhyItIsNotOne.what: My first local run of ./internal/dispatch/pmdoc/ at this head FAILED with 24 tests red in 847s.
pmdocLocalFailureAndWhyItIsNotOne.cause: Not the change and not the merge: every failure reads `differential.ts: exit status 1 ... Cannot find module 'proof-sdk-upstream/src/editor/schema/proof-marks' ... note: "proof-sdk@github:sjawhar/proof-sdk#dc6a852" not in cache, run `bun install`'. The pod was recreated at 03:33Z and its bun cache went with it; those tests shell out to a Bun differential against the editor's own parser.
pmdocLocalFailureAndWhyItIsNotOne.fix and re-measure: `bun install --frozen-lockfile` at the repository root (994 packages, 29.20s), then the four named failures re-run: ok 4.098s.
pmdocLocalFailureAndWhyItIsNotOne.corroboration: CI's own lanes at this head are green for the same code: envoy-go, envoy-go-race-pmdoc, envoy-go-race-docs, envoy-go-race-api, envoy-go-race and test all success.
pmdocLocalFailureAndWhyItIsNotOne.worthKnowing: A fresh pod cannot run the pmdoc differential tests until bun install has run, and the failure names Go test names rather than a missing dependency, so it reads as a product failure at first glance. That cost me 14 minutes twice.
